title: The Wheel Without the Guard — Shattered Angle-Grinder Disc Ballistics, Penetrating Maxillofacial & Orthopedic Trauma, Rotational Rim-Velocity Physics & Guard/RPM Verification

teenKit.tldr: Angle-grind tools spin at terrifyingly high speeds, and when a single safety guard is removed, a shattering abrasive disc can turn into a deadly high-velocity projectile. This episode breaks down the raw physics, forensic trauma, and surgical reality behind preventable shop accidents.
teenKit.whyItMatters: It shatters the illusion of safety around everyday household tools, reminding us that respect for physics separates a routine DIY project from a catastrophic medical emergency.
keyTakeaways: Angle-grinder discs store massive amounts of rotational kinetic energy, turning shrapnel into bullets when structural integrity fails.
Medical case studies from real surgical journals expose the exact maxillofacial and orthopedic devastation caused by unguarded high-speed tools.
Simple preventive habits—like never removing the safety guard and matching disc RPM ratings—are the absolute line between life and severe trauma.
